ranked.headline: Learned models infer transcriptomic structure from single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Pretrained and learned representations now transfer across tissues and predict expression directly from H&E histology images.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biological language models extend to DNA, mRNA and multimodal genomic tasks
ranked.summary: Preprints and a new published predictor test whether protein-model architectures transfer to DNA, mRNA and variant interpretation tasks.

ranked.headline: Simulation frameworks couple dynamical components to explore and infer biology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 publication pair mechanistic models with machine learning to recover parameters and detect rare dynamical regimes.

ranked.headline: Multimodal frameworks couple omics integration with spatial and single-cell validation
ranked.summary: Multimodal spatial, single-cell, and cell-free DNA datasets now demand integration methods that are evaluated against explicit, reproducible criteria.

ranked.headline: Pangenome assemblies resolve human repeat, mitochondrial-insertion and LINE-1 variation
ranked.summary: Long-read HPRC assemblies and graph-based methods now enable base-pair-resolved catalogs of repeats, NUMTs, and retrotransposon alleles across human…

ranked.headline: Pretrained DNA and protein language models adapted for regulatory and variant prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers steer, fine-tune, and interpret pretrained sequence models for regulatory and variant-effect tasks.

ranked.headline: Modeling Systematic Bias and Contamination in Genomic and Spatial Sequencing Data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target specific distortions in Hi-C, ChIP-seq, spatial and single-cell data, adding identifiability, stability and assessment criteria.

ranked.headline: Single-cell data are used to infer state dynamics and regulatory interventions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair single-cell snapshots with ODE, Neural ODE, and optimal transport models to infer transitions and interventions.

ranked.headline: Generative and graph models impose gene and spatial structure on single-cell data
ranked.summary: Destructive snapshots, batch effects, and sparse spatial measurements motivate models that encode gene-level or neighborhood structure explicitly.

ranked.headline: Metabolic profiling links lipid and glycan changes to kidney and diabetic heart disease
ranked.summary: Spatial, untargeted, and multi-omic readouts now yield interpretable indices linking molecular states to organ-level kidney and cardiac disease.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked computational tools infer genomic features from sequencing data
ranked.summary: New sequencing-inference tools are being judged against simulated data, controls, and independent evidence rather than accepted at face value.

ranked.headline: Inference from sparse biomedical data using calibrated, population-referenced models
ranked.summary: Sparse, censored and population-referenced biomedical data increasingly demand explicit model structure for calibrated inference.

ranked.headline: Validating short- and long-read pipelines for pathogen genome reconstruction
ranked.summary: Pathogen surveillance and preparedness now rely on benchmarked, standardized workflows converting raw Illumina and Nanopore reads into genomic outputs.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale metabolic models link protein, transport, and community function
ranked.summary: Learned protein and molecular representations are now being paired with genome-scale metabolic models to reconstruct networks and annotate function.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools bring interactive analysis to kinase, crystal and structure data
ranked.summary: Four May 2026 items describe packages automating kinase profiling, crystallographic refinement, virtual screening, and PDB file analysis.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map free-energy landscapes of conformational states in diverse proteins
ranked.summary: Recent MD studies of CFTR, LRRK2, calmodulin, and frataxin link electrostatics and mutations to functional conformational states.

ranked.headline: Deep models condition molecular and single-cell prediction on biological state
ranked.summary: Recent preprints embed transcriptomic state, structural confidence, and gene-level activity into deep models for drug design and response prediction.

ranked.headline: Software tools automate packaging, lab records, and workflows for reproducible analysis
ranked.summary: Recent R, Python, and lab-data tools make biological analysis portable, traceable, and scalable across packaging, workflow, and data-management layers.

ranked.headline: Interpretable brain encoding models reveal feature selectivity in human visual cortex
ranked.summary: Accuracy alone masks model-brain mismatch, so recent fMRI work inspects encoder internals and recovery profiles to ground selectivity claims.

ranked.headline: Predictive models for biomolecular endpoints gain ground but benchmarks remain uneven
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair foundation, geometric, and physics-informed models with new curated datasets and benchmarks for biomolecular prediction.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks encode biological priors to predict genes, drugs and biomarkers
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply schema-aware graph models to driver genes, drug repurposing and PAD biomarkers under label scarcity.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking long-read RNA methods reveals probe off-targeting and assembly artifacts
ranked.summary: Recent studies audit nanopore RNA workflows and RNA-chromatin datasets, exposing probe off-targeting and assembler artifacts in long reads.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level reference genomes for a bird, a red alga and an endangered lizard
ranked.summary: Long-read and Hi-C assemblies now extend contiguous reference genomes to a quail, two red algae and an endangered lizard.

ranked.headline: In silico kinetic and dynamic models test mechanisms of bacterial metabolic control
ranked.summary: Kinetic and hybrid simulations now discriminate candidate mechanisms in E. coli and B. subtilis, linking transport, regulation, and product yield.

ranked.headline: Simulations show membrane phase shaping peptide partitioning and protein organization
ranked.summary: Membrane-resolved simulations now pair residue, peptide, and ligand descriptors with explicit lipid composition and phase behavior.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models sharpen causal locus inference in genetic association studies
ranked.summary: Encoding haplotype, graph, and tissue or context structure is yielding finer-resolution association inference across MHC, GWAS, and eQTL settings.

ranked.headline: Curated HMMs and phylogenomic profiling refine microbial gene family annotation
ranked.summary: Phylogenomic analysis of ~22,000 NCBI genomes and a 17.73% sensitivity gain over KOfam illustrate curated annotation approaches.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings resolve residue states and cross-species assignments
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings and structural features are now applied to residue chemistry, orthology, and divergent genome annotation.

ranked.headline: Automated methods parametrize dihedrals and resolve macrocyclic peptide conformations
ranked.summary: Parameter generation for complex molecular models is moving toward automated workflows validated against QM profiles and NMR data.

ranked.headline: Constrained computational design and shape-based screening of peptides and ligands
ranked.summary: Four 2026 items pair computational design and screening with explicit constraints, spanning peptide optimization to shape-based ligand matching.

ranked.headline: First-passage timing and steady-state output decouple in stochastic regulatory models
ranked.summary: Recent stochastic models treat first-passage timing and steady-state output as separable readouts, including in phage lysis and lysogeny decisions.

ranked.headline: Noise and observation artifacts treated as inputs to stochastic model inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study model finite-data bias and stochastic agent dynamics explicitly during parameter inference.

ranked.headline: Open scriptable tools package omics analysis steps for reproducible workflows
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published tool emphasize reproducible, scriptable interfaces (CLI, Shiny, web) for individual omics analysis steps.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models tie cellular properties to rhythm switching and social learning
ranked.summary: Trainable and mechanistically explicit network models now yield testable mechanisms for rhythmic dynamics, skill acquisition, and EEG/fMRI activity.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link microbial colony and biofilm structure to physical drivers
ranked.summary: Quantitative models now couple geometry, force balance, and resource limitation to discrete microbial outcomes such as separation and detachment.

ranked.headline: Curated gene knowledge and literature tools are being packaged as software resources
ranked.summary: Fragmented gene panel data and inconsistent annotation motivate searchable, standardised tools for variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: Harmonized RNA-seq pipelines and resources for cross-species tumor transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Public RNA-seq archives are now being harmonized across technologies and species, enabling large-scale reanalysis of tumor and toxicant datasets.

ranked.headline: Physics-guided simulation resolves flexible complexes, oligomers and condensate behaviour
ranked.summary: Open condensate simulation tooling and experimentally constrained assembly of INO80 and cryo-EM complexes extend physics-based molecular modelling.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict protein-ligand binding affinity and pocket druggability
ranked.summary: Four preprints from May 2026 apply self-supervised, weakly supervised, and positive-unlabeled learning to binding affinity and druggability prediction.

ranked.headline: Sampling strategy governs which conformational states biomolecular methods recover
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of AlphaFold3, generative AI, and enhanced MD now test which conformational states each sampling approach actually recovers.
